title: Order-status handlers log full integration events including buyer name and identity GUID
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka; component: WebApp/
rationale: Identical one-line change in all six order-status handlers: the {@IntegrationEvent} destructuring (which serializes BuyerName and BuyerIdentityGuid into both the formatted message and structured state, exported via OTLP with no redaction) is replaced with @event.GetType().Name — correlation via @event.Id is preserved and the notification call on line 13 is untouched.
variants_checked: Grep confirms exactly six identical log sites in src/WebApp and that they are the only destructured-object log calls; BuyerName's only path into logs was this destructuring.
bypass_considered: No event property reaches the logger anymore; BuyerIdentityGuid still flows to NotifyOrderStatusChangedAsync (its intended push-notification purpose, not a log write); @event.Id is a correlation GUID, not PII.
test_note: Omitted — asserting log content statically requires compiling with an ILogger fake; recommend a FakeLogger unit test asserting no Buyer* keys when build capability is available.
review_reason: Root-cause fix at the exact emission site in all six sibling handlers; deterministic type name is not attacker-controlled; consistent structured-logging style.
